$comment: What the shared scripts, skills and agent need to know about AstroPhotoAnalyzer. With docs/skills.md, the only file edited here to use them; scripts/, .claude/skills/, .claude/agents/ and .claude/rules/kit/ are byte-identical with ../ClaudeCodeStarterKit's (scripts/sync.ps1 keeps them so; the kit's ADRs 0017, 0018 and 0028; ADR 0002). The projects sit at the folder root, not under src/ and tests/, so the folders are listed. The validation cases on the reference image stay out of the gate, and the image is a git-ignored copy in AstroPhotoAnalyzer.Tests/testdata/large/; APA_TESTDATA_LARGE is the override kit-config.ps1 requires a name for, and nobody sets it (ADR 0004). See scripts/kit-config.ps1 for every key.
